$comment: Coverage floors shared by the backend and frontend Vitest configs. Default coverage counts every eligible production source file, including files no test imports. Each config documents its narrow framework and test-infrastructure exclusions next to coverage.exclude.
backendComment: Full-source baseline measured 2026-09-15 after adding project membership and session execution authorization: 77.09 lines, 69.71 branches, 73.77 functions. The floors leave a small buffer for unrelated edits; integration-only tests remain outside this unit-coverage denominator.
backendImportedComment: Secondary imported-module baseline measured 2026-09-04: 82.51 lines, 74.53 branches, 78.60 functions. These legacy floors measure only modules loaded by tests. CI reports this scope as a nonblocking trend because adding or removing an import changes its denominator.
frontendComment: Full-source baseline measured 2026-09-04: 31.31 lines, 26.58 branches, 21.33 functions. The only framework exclusions are the root Next.js layout and route templates documented in apps/frontend/vitest.config.ts.
frontendImportedComment: Secondary imported-module baseline measured 2026-09-04: 71.63 lines, 70.70 branches, 57.16 functions. CI reports this scope as a nonblocking trend.

enforcement.description: The default commands enforce full-source floors. The explicit :imported commands retain the former import-graph measurements for diagnostics only.
